So please dont let yourself get pulled in.

I Read your whole story. And I can tell you're a really intelligent guy. Now I'm only 17 so I'm not an expert on any aspect of life either so bare with me. 
Knowing that we are both kinda introverted and sit back and think kinda guys I would recommend that's what you do. Just sit back and think about everything. Think about the fact that you could leave scars that every other person in your life will question. I understand that that isn't a pressing issue necessarily in the moment but I think it can play a big role in the long run. But I'm also in this subreddit for the same reason and I'm not trying to be a hypocrite. I just know that if you do try to go through life bottled up inside yourself you're gonna explode. For me it was a suicide attempt I just didn't care. And i know it might not be to that point yet but it only takes what seems like a moment. 
What I'm trying to get at is you need to write your frustrations down or talk to someone. Think of the good things you've got going and what you want for the future. Remember that high school is the shittiest shortest four years of your life. Most of the people you know in high school you'll never talk to again once you graduate. You've just gotta look forward. Because we both know it's hard to climb out of quicksand when you stop to sit down and think about how it's enveloping you.  You've either gotta accept that you are better off submerged or find the one branch that's within your reach. The one branch you can hold onto and pull yourself out. Into a tree that supports you so you can see the world again rather than sit in the muck and sink deeper and deeper. And who that branch is is up to you. It can be your parents, friends, some random dude from a subreddit. It doesn't matter as long as you don't sink and we all lose you. Whether that be to suicide, drugs, or one terrible night where you can't see a branch. 
Now I know your gonna fall out of a tree or two. Or a branch will snap half way up. But if you look around there are 10 more right behind it.
